items.name: Neagley
items.overview: Frances Neagley is a private investigator in Chicago and former military colleague of Jack Reacher in the Army's 110th Special Investigations Unit. When she learns that a beloved friend from her past has been killed in a suspicious accident, she becomes hell-bent on justice.

items.name: Stolen Heartbeats
items.overview: After an attack leaves a woman named Anabel comatose, she and Rafael—a nurse who has the unique ability to hear the dead—must work together to keep her alive while hiding from her enemies.

items.name: Nadu Center
items.overview: They fight, they fall, they rise... together!

items.name: Paap Kahini
items.overview: A simple village wife, who is the victim of her husband’s betrayal, takes terrible revenge on him. But what is that revenge?

items.name: Citadel
items.overview: What if you lost your memory? What if a spy didn't know they were a spy? Years ago, the top agents of Citadel, Mason Kane and Nadia Sinh, had their minds wiped. But, they're called back to action as sinister forces emerge from the past. With the help of spymaster Bernard Orlick, these former lovers must remember the past to save the future.

items.name: Mobaroknama
items.overview: Once an accomplished lawyer, Mobarok had retired after a case had rocked his moral foundation. Suddenly, a sensational case jolts the now-jaded man. Even after knowing that defeat in the case is inevitable, Mobarok returns to court because victory there is the only way to atone for his past mistake!

items.name: Monarch Legacy of Monsters
items.overview: After surviving Godzilla's attack on San Francisco, Cate is shaken yet again by a shocking secret. Amid monstrous threats, she embarks on a globetrotting adventure to learn the truth about her family—and the mysterious organization known as Monarch.

items.name: Mithya
items.overview: A tale of two women who are at odds with each other over allegations of plagiarism, which sparks a series of hostilities and shocking revelations spun around a murder for which they both are suspects.

items.name: Taxi Driver
items.overview: A former special forces soldier delivers revenge for victims of injustice while working for a secret organization that fronts as a taxi company.

items.name: The K2
items.overview: A patriotic bodyguard who was abandoned by his country and colleagues, a hidden daughter of leading Presidential candidate who regards love as a tool for revenge, and the First Lady contender who hides her ambition and charisma behind a kind and friendly personality.

items.name: Amidst A Snowstorm Of Love
items.overview: As a professional billiards player, Yin Guo has become quite a notable athlete. After receiving an invitation to play in a tournament in Hel, Yin Guo eagerly accepts. Little does she know that meeting former professional billiards player, Lin Yiyang, in Hel will change her life forever.

items.name: Bachelor Point
items.overview: Four young men from different districts of Bangladesh encounter various challenges as they try to live an independent life in the city, Dhaka.

items.name: Berlin and the Lady with an Ermine
items.overview: Hungry for a new heist, Berlin summons the gang to Seville and turns an ambitious duke into the victim of his own plan: to steal a da Vinci masterpiece.

cast.name: José Luis García Pérez
cast.character: Álvaro Hermoso de Medina, Duke of Málaga

items.name: Dadagiri Unlimited
items.overview: Dadagiri Unlimited is a  Bengali reality quiz show where contestants from different West Bengal districts compete in trivia rounds. Originally hosted by former Indian cricket captain Sourav Ganguly (Dada),currently hosted by tollywood actor Dev , the show blends competitive general knowledge with inspiring real-life stories of everyday heroes.

items.name: Dark Web
items.overview: Indra unwittingly hacks into an anonymous portal while searching for new video games. He soon realises that he is now a victim to a threat known as the Dark Web.

items.name: Debris
items.overview: Two federal agents from two different continents, and two different mindsets, must work together to investigate when wreckage from a destroyed alien spacecraft has mysterious effects on humankind.

items.name: Family Feud
items.overview: Two families compete against each other in a contest to name the most popular responses to a survey question posed to 100 people.

items.name: Family Full House With Rohit Sharma
items.overview: Family Full House with Rohit Sharma features Indian cricketer Rohit Sharma making his television hosting debut on Sony TV. The family-focused game show brings competing families together for fun, survey-based trivia infused with Rohit's signature laid-back wit and humor.

items.name: From
items.overview: Unravel the mystery of a nightmarish town in middle America that traps all those who enter. As the unwilling residents fight to keep a sense of normalcy and search for a way out, they must also survive the threats of the surrounding forest – including the terrifying creatures that come out when the sun goes down.

items.name: Indian Game Show
items.overview: The Indian Game Show is a high-energy comedy game show created and hosted by Bharti Singh and Haarsh Limbachiyaa. Featuring popular television actors, choreographers, musicians, and social media influencers, contestants face off in physical stunts, comedy challenges, and quirky tasks to win prizes while avoiding hilarious punishments

items.name: Its Okay to Not Be Okay
Kurulus Osman
items.overview: The epic continuation of Diriliş Ertuğrul, Kuruluş Osman follows Osman Bey — son of Ertuğrul and destined founder of the Ottoman Empire — as he transforms a small Turkic tribe into a sovereign state. Battling the Byzantine Empire, Mongol forces and treachery from within, Osman must prove himself as both a warrior and a leader. A sweeping historical action drama built on faith, honour and the birth of one of history's greatest empires.

items.name: Lucifer
items.overview: Bored and unhappy as the Lord of Hell, Lucifer Morningstar abandoned his throne and retired to Los Angeles, where he has teamed up with LAPD detective Chloe Decker to take down criminals. But the longer he's away from the underworld, the greater the threat that the worst of humanity could escape.

items.name: Lupin
items.overview: Inspired by the adventures of Arsène Lupin, gentleman thief Assane Diop sets out to avenge his father for an injustice inflicted by a wealthy family.

items.name: Mouse
items.overview: A psychopath's ruthless serial murders have left the entire nation gripped by fear and chaos. An honest, justice-seeking rookie police officer and a veteran detective with a tragic past, face off against the killer. After their encounter with the psychopath, their lives change completely.

items.name: My Bias My Boss
items.overview: A dedicated fangirl lands a job at a fashion company, only to discover it was co-founded by her ultimate idol. Determined to remain professional, she hides her identity, but is quickly thrown off course by the company's workaholic CEO. As secret unrequited feelings and hidden personal struggles entangle the trio, she finds herself torn between her lifelong obsession and an unexpected new connection.

items.name: Narcos
items.overview: A gritty chronicle of the war against Colombia's infamously violent and powerful drug cartels.

items.name: Naruto Shippuden
items.overview: After 2 and a half years Naruto finally returns to his village of Konoha, and sets about putting his ambitions to work. It will not be easy though as he has amassed a few more dangerous enemies, in the likes of the shinobi organization; Akatsuki.

items.name: One Piece
items.overview: With his straw hat and ragtag crew, young pirate Monkey D. Luffy goes on an epic voyage for treasure.

items.name: Queen of Tears
items.overview: The queen of department stores and the prince of supermarkets weather a marital crisis—until love miraculously begins to bloom again.

items.name: Rise And Fall
items.overview: The story revolves around the host explaining the show where 4 celebrities, of which 2 in the penthouse, are trying to maintain their position as Rulers while 2 in the basement are fighting to Rise to the Penthouse to topple a Ruler.

items.name: Rudrabinar Obhishaap
items.overview: Rudrapur and Anandagarh are two legendary schools of Indian classical music. However, these two places have a common past so dark that its revelation may change many lives forever.

items.name: See You at Work Tomorrow
items.overview: Cha Ji-yoon is a 7th-year corporate worker who's tired of both work and dating. She crosses paths with Kang Si-woo, the cynical boss with a terrifying reputation. Unexpectedly, she regains spark in her life as she gets to know the kindness behind his stern words. Amid repeated commutes, accidents at work, and failed relationships, the two become each other's irreplaceable anchor.

items.name: She Hulk Attorney at Law
items.overview: Jennifer Walters navigates the complicated life of a single, 30-something attorney who also happens to be a green 6-foot-7-inch superpowered hulk.

items.name: Squid Game The Challenge
items.overview: In this reality competition show inspired by "Squid Game," 456 players put their skills to the ultimate test for a life-changing $4.56 million prize.

items.name: Sweet Home
items.overview: As humans turn into savage monsters and the world plunges into terror, a handful of survivors fight for their lives — and to hold on to their humanity.

items.name: Taqdeer
items.overview: Freezer van driver Taqdeer spirals into a dark game of destiny after he finds the unclaimed dead body of a woman in his truck.

items.name: Teen Wolf
items.overview: Scott McCall, a high school student living in the town of Beacon Hills has his life drastically changed when he's bitten by a werewolf, becoming one himself. He must henceforth learn to balance his problematic new identity with his day-to-day teenage life. The following characters are instrumental to his struggle: Stiles, his best friend; Allison, his love interest who comes from a family of werewolf hunters; and Derek, a mysterious werewolf with a dark past. Throughout the series, he strives to keep his loved ones safe while maintaining normal relationships with them.

items.name: The Big Bang Theory
items.overview: Physicists Leonard and Sheldon find their nerd-centric social circle with pals Howard and Raj expanding when aspiring actress Penny moves in next door.

items.name: The Family Man
items.overview: A widowed fire chief tries to raise his four children with help from his father-in-law.

items.name: The Great Indian Kapil Show
items.overview: Comedian Kapil Sharma hosts this laugh-out-loud variety talk show with celebrity guests, hilarious antics and his signature supporting cast.

items.name: The Ordinary Jackpot
items.overview: An ordinary office worker wins the lottery – the amount isn't enough for him to quit his job, but it's enough to give him a new outlook on life.

items.name: The Strain
items.overview: A high concept thriller that tells the story of Dr. Ephraim Goodweather, the head of the Center for Disease Control Canary Team in New York City. He and his team are called upon to investigate a mysterious viral outbreak with hallmarks of an ancient and evil strain of vampirism. As the strain spreads, Eph, his team, and an assembly of everyday New Yorkers, wage war for the fate of humanity itself.

items.name: The Traitors
items.overview: Strangers play the ultimate game of detection, backstabbing and trust in the hope of winning up to £120,000. But hidden amongst the players are three Traitors, who secretly ‘murder’ a player every night. It’s up to the Faithfuls to banish them from the game before they become the next victim. If the Faithfuls eliminate all the Traitors they split the cash; but if a Traitor remains undetected to the end of the game, they take all the money.

items.name: The Uncanny Counter
items.overview: A group of supernatural demon hunters known as "Counters," each with unique abilities, disguise themselves as employees of a noodle restaurant, while tracking down evil spirits that terrorize the mortal world.

items.name: Welcome to Waikiki
items.overview: Kang Dong-Goo dreams of becoming a movie director, but he is cynical due to bad luck. Cheon Joon-Ki wanted to follow in his father's footsteps and become an actor, but he is now just a minor actor. Bong-Doo-Sik came to Seoul to become a scenario writer, but things have not been easy for him.
